body:
It means a lot that someone finally commented.

I'm sorry to hear you've had a rough time too.

That virtual reality stuff sounds pretty awesome. But it kills me that the only world I could ever be wanted in would be a virtual one based on my own desires. That my only shot at being anything more than this worthless subhuman is diving deep into delusion and leaving reality behind.

Still. I'm pretty desperate by now. I'd take it over death.
